content: Saray, tamɣart n Abram, war d as dd-tiruw ca. Tuɣa ɣares ict n tayya zi Miṣra qqarent as Hajar.
Tenna Saray i Abram: “Aqa teẓrid belli SIDI iṭṭef xafi tarwa. Adef x tayya inu, balak ad zzayes ksiɣ tarwa.” Abram tuɣa issḥessa ɣar Saray.
Awarni řami izdeɣ Abram ɛecra n iseggʷusa di temmurt n Kenɛan, tiwi-dd Saray, tamɣart n Abram, tayya nnes Hajar, tenni zi Miṣra, uca tewca as-dd i Abram, aryaz nnes, d tamɣart nnes.
Yudef x Hajar uca nettat teksi ddeyset. Umi teẓra belli teksi ddeyset, xenni tedweř lallas tᵉttwasseḥqar di tiṭṭawin nnes.
Tenna Saray i Abram: “Zi ssibbet nnec ggin dayi řmunkar. Necc ggiɣ tayya inu deg weḥsin nnec. Umi teẓra belli teksi ddeyset, dewřeɣ d tameḥguret di tiṭṭawin nnes. Ejj ad iḥkem SIDI jar ayi d cek!”
Inna Abram i Saray: “Xzar, tayya nnem deg ifassen nnem. Egg zzayes min tᵉttwařid cem mliḥ di tiṭṭawin nnem.” Uca Saray tqemmeɛ i-tt u xenni nettat tarweř zzayes.
Uca lmalak n SIDI iřqa i-tt ɣar tařa n waman di řexřa, ɣar tařa deg webrid ittawyen ɣar Cur.
Inna: “Hajar, tayya n Saray, manis dd-tusid u mani ɣa traḥed?” Nettat tenna: “Ttrakkwařeɣ zeg wudem n lalla Saray!”
Xenni inna as lmalak n SIDI: “Dweř ɣar lallam, uḍar sadu ifassen nnes.”
Inna as ɛawed lmalak n SIDI: “Ad kettareɣ aṭṭas zzariɛet nnem, ař war izemmar ad tᵉttwaḥseb řami i ɣa tiři deg waṭṭas.”
Inna as lmalak n SIDI ɛawed: “Aqa řexxu, teksid ddeyset uca ad tarwed aseymi. Ad as tegged Ismaɛil, minzi SIDI isřa am di řemḥayen nnem.
Uca netta ad yiři d ijj n bnadem amecnaw asnus n řexřa. Afus nnes ad yiři x marra, u afus n marra ad yiři xas. Ad izdeɣ arendad n marra aytmas.”
U nettat třaɣa x Yisem n SIDI i ɣares-dd issiwřen, tenna: “Cek d Arebbi i ittwařan!”, minzi tenna: “Ma war da ẓriɣ wenni d ayi ittwařan?”
X uya semman anu nni: anu ‘Laḥay-Ru’i’. Xzar, aqa-t jar Qadac d Barad.
Uca turuw-dd Hajar i Abram aseymi. Igga as Abram isem n mmis nni i d as dd-turuw Hajar ‘Ismaɛil’.
Abram tuɣa ɣares setta u-tmanyin n iseggʷusa, umi dd-turuw Hajar Ismaɛil i Abram.

footnotes.text: ɣar Saray- am ikmeř ‘ɣar tmijja n Saray’.
Cur- isem wanita ixs ad yini ‘řḥiḍ’. Tandint-a tuɣa ɣar weymir jar Kenɛan d Miṣra.
Ismaɛil- isem-a wanita ixs ad yini ‘Arebbi ad iseř’ niɣ ‘wenni umi i ɣa iseř Arebbi’ niɣ ‘wenni i d as ittesřan Arebbi’.
anu Laḥay-Ru’i- isem-a wanita ixs ad yini ‘anu n wenni iddaren u ixzar dayi’. Barad- isem-a wanita ixs ad yini ‘tebrurri’.
